items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Every live file that repeats the claim that GitHub's server-side merge honors merge=union now says it applies to local merges only (.gitattributes, template, gitattributes_union.py docstring, adopt step-E doc, hooks-and-pipeline.md x3, one test comment). Historical records (decision log, past iterate specs, CHANGELOG, conventions.md learnings) are left as written.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Comment and documentation wording only; no executable path changed.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No input, secret, or permission surface touched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: No behavior changed, so no new test; the managed-block marker (first template line) is unchanged and the four gitattributes test files plus the adopt scaffold test pass; full F0 suite green (24562 tests, 0 failed, 107 skipped).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Wording follows the existing comment style; the template stays an LF file with the same managed-marker first line, so self-heal still recognises already scaffolded blocks.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The template text is copied into managed repos by adopt and self-heal. Existing managed repos keep their old wording until they change (merge_into only appends missing rules, never rewrites an existing block), which is harmless for a comment.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: One comment line edited in an existing test; no skip, xfail or assertion touched.
